scope: Registered Bend cave-field and carving correctness; unlit component, no complete generator or performance claim

cave_fields_and_voxels.scope:
Independent cave-field, carving and compressed-chunk checks.

This component uses registered density/carvers, coherent tunnel noise and finite
rounded ravines. Cave biomes, aquifers, decorations and world integration remain
pending. Correctness-run timings are not a generator benchmark.

complete_carved_regions.scope:
Decode complete Bend MCA output after GPU/CPU cave carving.

The analytic chamber crosses many chunks in a full 512x512 resident tile. All
1024 records are independently decoded; selected chunks must match resident
carved queries and heightmaps. This is unlit component output, not completed
generation or a Rust-versus-Bend benchmark.
